priors.frame: Local gravity-aligned frame; origin and initial yaw are chosen, not recovered absolute coordinates.

receives: public HIGHRES_IMU sample timestamps, gyro and acceleration
invariants: Preserve header, estimated device and host receipt times separately
Published time differences are not verified physics integration intervals
Native pose/course/race/actuator reports do not enter the navigator

interfaces.produces: Measured pixel constraints with image ID, timestamp, type and quality
invariants: Full aperture has four observed corners
Clipped outer top has two observed corners

interfaces.owns: Persistent visual identity; mission ordinal is separate
invariants: Full/partial features of the same red component refer to the same object
Compare depth ordering only for distinct objects
Require three distinct images for a nearer target change
Strong tracked pixel correspondence can correct uncertain depth

interfaces.receives: Assigned raw constraints, public gyro and own command/model history
interfaces.required_method: Fixed-lag error-state EKF with joint vehicle/current-next landmark covariance. Apply raw pixel factors at their estimated image epochs; replay subsequent public gyro, own commands and visual events. Keep a1s history; estimate at the command epoch. Published sample elapsed time supports the gyro/command model, not exact accelerometer preintegration.
interfaces.current_method: Optional joint error-state EKF (--joint-estimator): raw aperture/top pixels and public body specific force update p/v/attitude/biases and gate geometry together. Rewind and replay every later process and measurement event. The default course observer remains complementary.

interfaces.receives: Relative gate posterior, motion state, model uncertainty and feature visibility
interfaces.produces: Time-indexed position, velocity and acceleration reference
interfaces.required_method: Choose minimum-time feasible short trajectory with crossing margin, actuator and camera-visibility constraints
interfaces.current_method: Position waypoints with coarse visibility alignment, plus optional predictive crossing constraint. Near a gate, brake and align in the transverse plane if the constant-velocity crossing prediction exceeds0.55m. Joint posterior chance constraints and a timed trajectory remain absent.

interfaces.owns: Position/attitude feedback, public-gyro rate PI, mixer and limits
invariants: Every requested rate and motor value is recorded
Control timing measurements do not influence decisions

interfaces.receives: Frozen pilot decisions, public data and privileged native references
interfaces.produces: One pipeline report, plots and acceptance outcome
invariants: Use one fixed origin/yaw alignment; no scale fit
Exact normal and poisoned replay verify runtime independence
Model-training provenance is audited separately from poisoned replay

estimation: position m, velocity m/s, attitude deg against scorer
control: per-stage wall and thread CPU time
timing: Image final-packet receipt to candidate-ready and next send-return on host monotonic clock
Latest retained IMU receipt to send-return
Estimated image clock age and velocity-fit effective age separately

current_gaps: Posterior coverage remains uneven on longer recorded flights; the joint observer has live validation for one slow gate.
The planner still uses mean-state crossing constraints and coarse visibility waypoints.
Gate binding uses confirmed nearer hypotheses; it does not report calibrated identity probabilities.
True camera exposure and physical IMU integration intervals are unknown. The joint path uses published epochs and body-force observations without exact accelerometer preintegration.
Force calibration support is narrow; larger speeds and tilt need new validation.
acceptance_protocol: Freeze source and calibration hashes, declare trial count and starts, report every attempt, score each stage and the full native flight, then remove raw recordings after exact normal/poisoned replay.

next_checkpoint.backend: Joint observer now implemented; next test two gates without resetting, then consume relative covariance in braking/visibility planning.
next_checkpoint.inputs: Raw public replay dataset and measured pixels; no native fitting labels
next_checkpoint.acceptance: Five prospective unchanged two-gate flights from both shifts: two native-valid ordered gates, zero contacts/resets, exact normal and poisoned replay. Velocity/depth diagnostic targets remain goals.
next_checkpoint.planner_condition: abs(mean crossing offset)+3*sigma_crossing <=0.55m in both transverse axes; calibrate coverage before treating this as a probability. Include position/landmark/velocity cross-covariances.

calibration.gate_size: Nominal1.5m aperture is an explicit scale prior, not a fitted native opening dimension.
calibration.support: Mean motor command0.2598–0.2970; larger thrust/speed/tilt require new public-data identification and validation.
